concepts.name: Variable declarations let const
concepts.summary: Explain how let, const and var declare variables and choose const by default and let when reassignment is needed.

concepts.name: Primitive and object types
concepts.summary: Recall JavaScript's primitive types, objects, arrays and the typeof operator.

concepts.name: Strict versus loose equality
concepts.summary: Explain why === avoids type coercion and what truthy and falsy values are.

concepts.name: Function declarations and expressions
concepts.summary: Write and call functions with parameters and return values, including function expressions.

concepts.name: Template literals
concepts.summary: Build strings with interpolated expressions and multiline text using backticks.

concepts.name: Object and array literals
concepts.summary: Create objects and arrays and access their members with dot and bracket notation.

concepts.name: Console output and debugging
concepts.summary: Use console methods to inspect values and read basic error messages.

misconceptions.text: const makes the value completely immutable, even for objects and arrays.
typeof null returns 'null' and arrays have the type 'array'.

concepts.name: Arrow function syntax
concepts.summary: Write arrow functions with implicit returns and recognise when they are appropriate.

concepts.name: Destructuring and spread
concepts.summary: Extract values from arrays and objects and copy or merge them using spread and rest syntax.

concepts.name: Map filter reduce
concepts.summary: Transform, select and aggregate arrays with map, filter and reduce instead of manual loops.

concepts.name: JSON parsing and serialising
concepts.summary: Convert between objects and JSON strings and know what values JSON cannot represent.

concepts.name: Block scope and hoisting
concepts.summary: Predict how var, let and const are scoped and hoisted, including the temporal dead zone.

concepts.name: DOM selection and modification
concepts.summary: Select elements and change their text, attributes, classes and styles.

concepts.name: Event listeners
concepts.summary: Attach handlers to elements and use the event object to respond to user actions.

misconceptions.text: map modifies the original array in place.
let and const variables are not hoisted at all.
Spread creates a deep copy of nested objects.

concepts.name: Lexical scope and closures
concepts.summary: Analyse how functions retain access to variables of their defining scope and use this for private state.

concepts.name: this binding rules
concepts.summary: Determine the value of this from call-site, call/apply/bind, and arrow function lexical binding.

concepts.name: Prototype chain lookup
concepts.summary: Trace property lookup along the prototype chain and distinguish own from inherited properties.

concepts.name: ES6 class syntax
concepts.summary: Define classes with constructors, methods, static members and inheritance via extends and super.

concepts.name: ES module import export
concepts.summary: Organise code with named and default exports and imports and understand module scope.

concepts.name: Event propagation and delegation
concepts.summary: Analyse capture and bubble phases and use delegation to handle events on dynamic elements.

concepts.name: Shallow versus deep copying
concepts.summary: Distinguish reference sharing, shallow copies and deep copies and pick a suitable cloning approach.

misconceptions.text: Closures capture the value of a variable at creation time rather than the variable itself.
JavaScript classes work like classes in Java, copying methods into instances.
this refers to the function itself or the lexical scope where it is defined, in every function type.

concepts.name: Prototype-based design tradeoffs
concepts.summary: Evaluate classes, factory functions, and Object.create composition for a given design.

concepts.name: Module design and dependencies
concepts.summary: Assess module structure, circular imports, live bindings and side effects at import time.

concepts.name: Functional composition patterns
concepts.summary: Compose pure functions, currying and higher-order utilities and judge when they improve clarity.

concepts.name: Immutability strategies
concepts.summary: Evaluate approaches such as spread updates, Object.freeze and non-mutating array methods for avoiding shared-state bugs.

concepts.name: Property descriptors and getters
concepts.summary: Use property descriptors, getters, setters and enumerability to control object behaviour.

concepts.name: Symbols and iteration protocols
concepts.summary: Analyse how iterables and iterators power for...of, spread and destructuring, and implement custom ones.

concepts.name: DOM performance and reflow
concepts.summary: Evaluate DOM update strategies such as batching, fragments and avoiding forced layout.

misconceptions.text: Object.freeze makes nested objects deeply immutable.
Functional style with map and reduce is always faster and clearer than loops.
Imported bindings are copies of the exported values.

concepts.name: Language semantics critique
concepts.summary: Judge the impact of coercion, hoisting and this quirks on code style and enforce safer conventions.

concepts.name: Metaprogramming with Proxy
concepts.summary: Design objects with Proxy and Reflect traps for validation or observation while weighing costs.

concepts.name: Library API architecture
concepts.summary: Create a coherent, extensible, module-based API using appropriate patterns for inheritance, composition and configuration.

concepts.name: Memory leaks and garbage collection
concepts.summary: Diagnose leaks from closures, detached DOM nodes and lingering listeners and evaluate fixes.

concepts.name: Engine optimisation awareness
concepts.summary: Evaluate how object shape stability and type consistency affect engine optimisation without premature tuning.

concepts.name: Custom event architectures
concepts.summary: Design decoupled component communication using custom events and a clear listener lifecycle.

concepts.name: Conventions and style standards
concepts.summary: Create team conventions and lint configurations that prevent known language pitfalls.

misconceptions.text: Garbage collection means JavaScript programs cannot leak memory.
Micro-optimising code by hand is the best way to speed up JavaScript.
Proxies are a free abstraction with no performance or semantic cost.
